legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.s1.p: BizNet connects businesses that need packaging and disposables with suppliers who quote for that need. BizNet is not a party to any deal between a buyer and a supplier.
legal.terms.s2.p: You are responsible for what is done through your account and your business. Give true information about your business, and keep your sign-in methods to yourself.
legal.terms.s3.p: A quote is the supplier's own offer. An order records the terms both sides confirmed. Payment for goods happens outside BizNet, directly between buyer and supplier.
legal.terms.s4.p: AI features help you write and compare, and they can be wrong. Prices, quantities and dates always come from what users entered. Check them before you confirm anything.
legal.terms.s5.p: We may suspend a business or remove content that breaks these terms or the community rules.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.s1.p: Your sign-in phone or email, your business profile, and the requests, quotes, orders, messages and files you add.
legal.privacy.s2.p: Business profiles and listings are public without a phone number. Contact details are shared only under the contact-reveal rules or after an order. Verification documents are visible to admins only.
legal.privacy.s3.p: We use outside providers to send messages, store files and run AI and translation features. They receive only what the feature needs.
legal.privacy.s4.p: You can update your details in your account. To ask for your data or for its deletion, contact the BizNet team.
legal.community.title: Community rules
legal.community.s1.p: Describe your needs, products and prices truthfully. Do not post quotes you do not intend to honour.
legal.community.s2.h: Discussion is for help, not ads
legal.community.s2.p: Ask and answer practical questions. Selling posts are held for review or refused. Post a request or a listing instead.
legal.community.s3.h: Keep contact details in the rules
legal.community.s3.p: Do not share phone numbers or links in messages to get around the contact-reveal step.
legal.community.s4.p: Use the report action on content that breaks these rules. Admins review reports and may remove content or suspend a business.
